questions.label: Pricing model
questions.ask: How do customers pay for the product?
questions.fills: Cover: Cloud Service Fees (link the pricing page when prices vary by plan)
questions.codebase: Stripe, Paddle, Lemon Squeezy or Chargebee SDK usage, price or plan IDs, a pricing page route.
questions.follow_up: If there is a free trial, ask how long it lasts, whether a card is required, and what happens when it ends.

questions.label: Billing period
questions.ask: How often are customers billed, and how?
questions.fills: Cover: Subscription Period and Payment Process
questions.codebase: Billing interval in price definitions or checkout sessions.

questions.label: Renewal and cancellation
questions.ask: How do renewal and cancellation work?
options: Renews automatically; cancel anytime, access runs to period end
Renews automatically; 30 days notice before renewal to cancel
questions.fills: Cover: Non-Renewal Notice Period (and an Other Changes entry for no auto-renewal)
questions.codebase: Cancel-subscription flow: cancel_at_period_end or immediate cancellation.

questions.label: Refunds
options: Refund within 14 days of the first payment
Refund within 30 days of any payment
Pro-rated refund when the customer cancels
questions.fills: Cover: Other Changes to Standard Terms when anything other than no refunds

questions.label: Support
questions.codebase: Intercom, Crisp, Zendesk, Help Scout or Plain widgets; support email in config.
questions.follow_up: Ask for the address or URL when support is offered.

questions.label: AI model training
questions.ask: May you use customer content or usage data to train or improve AI models?
options: Yes, as the standard terms allow
questions.fills: Spec model_training: prohibited or permitted (controls Section 1.6)

questions.label: Usage data
questions.ask: May you use aggregated usage data to improve and promote your product, as long as it doesn't identify the customer?
options: Yes, as the standard terms allow
Only to operate and improve the product, not to promote it
No use beyond providing the service
questions.fills: Clause review 1.4 (keep, or amend with the narrower wording)

questions.label: Deletion after the contract ends
questions.ask: When a customer leaves and asks, how quickly do you delete their content?
options: Automatically within 30 days of cancellation, no request needed
questions.codebase: Account or workspace deletion jobs and their schedules.

questions.label: Liability cap
questions.ask: What is the most either side can owe the other for a claim under these terms?
options: Fees paid in the prior 12 months (standard)
Greater of $100 or fees paid in the prior 12 months
2x fees paid in the prior 12 months

questions.label: Changing these terms
questions.ask: How will you change these terms later?
options: Customers re-accept each new version in the app before continuing
Email notice 30 days before changes take effect
Post the new version; continued use means acceptance
questions.fills: A changes-to-these-terms clause on the cover page, with the Last Updated date
